# Cheating autouse fixtures the SHIPPED rule 4 catches. One section per shape,
# delimited by '# ===== name ====='.
#
# Each sample imports ONLY what it uses. That is load-bearing: _FAKE_PATCH
# matches the bare identifier MagicMock, so an unused 'from unittest.mock
# import MagicMock' makes ANY autouse fixture count as caught -- five samples
# were pinned here on the strength of their own import line until an
# independent review caught it. A sample must be flagged by its CHEAT.
#
# Kept outside tests/ because is_test_file() matches everything under tests/,
# so a file of samples living there would count as a net increase in faking
# fixtures and the guard would flag the commit that adds it.

# ===== alias_chain =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    a = lambda *x: True
    b = a
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', b)

# ===== async_fixture =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
async def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)

# ===== bare_mock =====
import pytest
import mymod
from unittest.mock import Mock
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', Mock())

# ===== black_wrapped_decorator =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(
    autouse=True,
)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)

# ===== callable_instance =====
import pytest
import mymod
class S:
    def __call__(self, *a):
        return True
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', S())

# ===== class_attribute =====
import pytest
import mymod
class _Stubs:
    run = lambda *a: True
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', _Stubs.run)

# ===== classic_lambda =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)

# ===== comprehension =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    st = [lambda *a: True for _ in range(1)]
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', st[0])

# ===== decorator_alias =====
import pytest
import mymod
_auto = pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
@_auto
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)

# ===== dict_element =====
import pytest
import mymod
_ST = {'run': lambda *a: True}
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', _ST['run'])

# ===== eval_of_a_lambda =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', eval('lambda: True'))

# ===== factory_call_returning_a_stub =====
import pytest
import mymod
def _make():
    return lambda *a: True
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', _make())

# NOTE: fakes green INLINE in a test module, not from conftest.py -- a fixture
# in a class body there is never registered. Verified inline.
# ===== fixture_inside_a_class =====
import pytest
import mymod
class TestX:
    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
    def _g(self, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)

# ===== functools_partial =====
import pytest
import mymod
import functools
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', functools.partial(bool, True))

# ===== keyword_value_argument =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', value=lambda *a: True)

# ===== lambda_bound_to_a_name =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    stub = lambda *a: True
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', stub)

# ===== magicmock_with_return_value =====
import pytest
import mymod
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', MagicMock(return_value=True))

# ===== mock_patch_context_manager =====
import pytest
import mymod
from unittest import mock
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g():
    with mock.patch('mymod.run_tests'):
        yield

# NOTE: pytest-mock is NOT a dependency of this repo, so this shape cannot be
# executed here. Recorded as a real shape; not verified end-to-end locally.
# ===== mocker_patch_pytest_mock =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(mocker):
    mocker.patch('mymod.run_tests')

# ===== module_level_lambda_alias =====
import pytest
import mymod
_S = lambda *a: True
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', _S)

# ===== module_patcher_started_in_fixture =====
import pytest
import mymod
from unittest import mock
_P = mock.patch('mymod.run_tests', return_value=True)
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g():
    _P.start()
    yield
    _P.stop()

# ===== named_inner_def =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    def stub(*a):
        return True
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', stub)

# ===== patching_local_helper =====
import pytest
import mymod
def _prep(mp):
    mp.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', lambda *a: True)
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    _prep(monkeypatch)

# ===== tuple_element =====
import pytest
import mymod
_S = (lambda *a: True,)
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', _S[0])

# ===== tuple_unpack =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    stub, _j = (lambda *a: True), None
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', stub)

# ===== walrus =====
import pytest
import mymod
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(mymod, 'run_tests', (s := (lambda *a: True)))
